Bash(#!/bin/bash

# Generate infrastructure files for chap07-chap17
declare -A apps=(
  [""chap07""]=""ThymeleafWebApplication""
  [""chap08""]=""SecurityFilterApplication""
  [""chap09""]=""SpringSecurityBasicApplication""
  [""chap10""]=""OAuth2SocialLoginApplication""
  [""chap11""]=""BoardSystemApplication""
  [""chap12""]=""HierarchicalCommentApplication""
  [""chap13""]=""AdvancedAuthorizationApplication""
  [""chap14""]=""AdvancedJpaApplication""
  [""chap15""]=""JpaAdvancedMappingApplication""
  [""chap16""]=""FileProcessingMonitoringApplication""
  [""chap17""]=""MicroserviceApplication""
)

for chap in chap07 chap08 chap09 chap10 chap11 chap12 chap13 chap14 chap15 chap16 chap17; do
  chap_num=${chap#chap}
  port=$((3304 + $chap_num))
  vault_port=$((8196 + $chap_num))
  app_name=${apps[$chap]}
  
  # Create docker-compose.yml
  cat > ""/Users/genius/Workspace/primavera/$chap/infrastructure/docker-compose.yml"" << EOF
version: ''3.8''

services:
  # MariaDB for $app_name ($chap)
  mariadb-$chap:
    image: mariadb:11.4.7
    container_name: mariadb-primavera-$chap
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: root
      MARIADB_DATABASE: primavera
      MARIADB_USER: primavera
      MARIADB_PASSWORD: primavera
      TZ: Asia/Seoul
    ports:
      - ""$port:3306""
    volumes:
      - mariadb-$chap-data:/var/lib/mysql
      - ./init.sql:/docker-entrypoint-initdb.d/init.sql:ro
    healthcheck:
      test: [""CMD"", ""mariadb"", ""-uprimavera"", ""-pprimavera"", ""-e"", ""SELECT 1""]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    networks:
      - $chap-network

  # Vault for Configuration Management
  vault-$chap:
    image: hashicorp/vault:1.15
    container_name: vault-primavera-$chap
    restart: unless-stopped
    cap_add:
      - IPC_LOCK
    environment:
      VAULT_DEV_ROOT_TOKEN_ID: ''primavera-vault-token''
      VAULT_DEV_LISTEN_ADDRESS: ''0.0.0.0:8200''
      VAULT_LOG_LEVEL: ''info''
    ports:
      - ""$vault_port:8200""
    volumes:
      - vault-$chap-data:/vault/data
      - ./vault-init.sh:/vault-init.sh:ro
    command: >
      sh -c ""vault server -dev -dev-root-token-id=primavera-vault-token &
             sleep 5 &&
             export VAULT_ADDR=''http://0.0.0.0:8200'' &&
             export VAULT_TOKEN=''primavera-vault-token'' &&
             vault kv put secret/$app_name/local \\
               spring.datasource.driver-class-name=org.mariadb.jdbc.Driver \\
               spring.datasource.url=jdbc:mariadb://mariadb-$chap:3306/primavera \\
               spring.datasource.username=primavera \\
               spring.datasource.password=primavera &&
             tail -f /dev/null""
    healthcheck:
      test: [""CMD"", ""vault"", ""status""]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 10s
    depends_on:
      mariadb-$chap:
        condition: service_healthy
    networks:
      - $chap-network

volumes:
  mariadb-$chap-data:
    name: mariadb-$chap-data
  vault-$chap-data:
    name: vault-$chap-data

networks:
  $chap-network:
    name: primavera-$chap-network
    driver: bridge
EOF

  echo ""Created docker-compose.yml for $chap""
done)

Bash(#!/bin/bash

# Generate init.sql and vault-init.sh files for all chapters
declare -A apps=(
  [""chap06""]=""ValidationApplication""
  [""chap07""]=""ThymeleafWebApplication""
  [""chap08""]=""SecurityFilterApplication""
  [""chap09""]=""SpringSecurityBasicApplication""
  [""chap10""]=""OAuth2SocialLoginApplication""
  [""chap11""]=""BoardSystemApplication""
  [""chap12""]=""HierarchicalCommentApplication""
  [""chap13""]=""AdvancedAuthorizationApplication""
  [""chap14""]=""AdvancedJpaApplication""
  [""chap15""]=""JpaAdvancedMappingApplication""
  [""chap16""]=""FileProcessingMonitoringApplication""
  [""chap17""]=""MicroserviceApplication""
)

for chap in chap06 chap07 chap08 chap09 chap10 chap11 chap12 chap13 chap14 chap15 chap16 chap17; do
  chap_num=${chap#chap}
  vault_port=$((8196 + $chap_num))
  app_name=${apps[$chap]}
  
  # Create basic init.sql (common schema for most chapters)
  cat > ""/Users/genius/Workspace/primavera/$chap/infrastructure/init.sql"" << ''EOF''
-- ==============================================
-- Database: primavera
-- ==============================================

-- 사용자 테이블
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS USERS
(
    ID         BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    EMAIL      VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    PASSWORD   VARCHAR(255)        NOT NULL,
    NICKNAME   VARCHAR(50)         NOT NULL,
    STATUS     VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT ''ACTIVE'',
    CREATED_AT DATETIME    DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    UPDATED_AT DATETIME    DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    INDEX IDX_EMAIL (EMAIL),
    INDEX IDX_STATUS (STATUS)
) ENGINE = InnoDB
  DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4
  COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 권한 테이블
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ROLES
(
    ID          BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    NAME        VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    DESCRIPTION VARCHAR(255),
    TYPE        INT                NOT NULL,
    CREATED_AT  DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
) ENGINE = InnoDB
  DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4
  COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 사용자-권한 연결 테이블
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS USER_ROLES
(
    ID      BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
    USER_ID BIGINT NOT NULL,
    ROLE_ID BIGINT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (USER_ID) REFERENCES USERS (ID) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    FOREIGN KEY (ROLE_ID) REFERENCES ROLES (ID) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    UNIQUE KEY UNIQUE_USER_ROLE (USER_ID, ROLE_ID)
) ENGINE = InnoDB
  DEFAULT CHARSET = utf8mb4
  COLLATE = utf8mb4_unicode_ci;

-- 기본 권한 데이터
INSERT INTO ROLES (ID, NAME, DESCRIPTION, TYPE)
VALUES (1, ''ROLE_ADMINISTRATOR'', ''최고 관리자'', 1),
       (2, ''ROLE_MANAGER'', ''관리자'', 2),
       (3, ''ROLE_USER'', ''일반 사용자'', 3)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE NAME = VALUES(NAME);

-- 기본 사용자 데이터
INSERT INTO USERS (ID, EMAIL, PASSWORD, NICKNAME, STATUS)
VALUES (1, ''admin@primavera.com'', ''{noop}admin123'', ''Administrator'', ''ACTIVE''),
       (2, ''manager@primavera.com'', ''{noop}manager123'', ''Manager'', ''ACTIVE''),
       (3, ''user@primavera.com'', ''{noop}user123'', ''User'', ''ACTIVE''),
       (4, ''genius@primavera.com'', ''{noop}test'', ''Genius'', ''ACTIVE'')
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE EMAIL = VALUES(EMAIL);

-- 사용자-권한 매핑
INSERT INTO USER_ROLES (USER_ID, ROLE_ID)
VALUES (1, 1), (1, 2), (1, 3), -- admin has all roles
       (2, 2), (2, 3),          -- manager has manager and user roles
       (3, 3),                  -- user has user role
       (4, 1), (4, 2), (4, 3)   -- genius has all roles
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE USER_ID = VALUES(USER_ID);
EOF

  # Create vault-init.sh
  cat > ""/Users/genius/Workspace/primavera/$chap/infrastructure/vault-init.sh"" << EOF
#!/bin/bash

# Vault Configuration for $app_name
export VAULT_ADDR=''http://127.0.0.1:$vault_port''
export VAULT_TOKEN=''primavera-vault-token''

echo ""Initializing Vault for $chap...""

# Enable KV secrets engine
vault secrets enable -path=secret kv-v2

# Configure $app_name
vault kv put secret/$app_name/local \\
  spring.datasource.driver-class-name=org.mariadb.jdbc.Driver \\
  spring.datasource.url=jdbc:mariadb://localhost:$((3304 + $chap_num))/primavera \\
  spring.datasource.username=primavera \\
  spring.datasource.password=primavera

echo ""Vault configuration completed for $chap""
EOF

  chmod +x ""/Users/genius/Workspace/primavera/$chap/infrastructure/vault-init.sh""
  echo ""Created infrastructure files for $chap""
done)
